title: Component API rules
description: Component structure rules for React and Preact: typed props, variants, polymorphism, refs, nesting and keys.

rules.title: Exported component props untyped or any
rules.message: An exported component has untyped or any-typed props.
rules.rationale: Untyped props remove the contract that makes components safe to reuse.

rules.title: More than four boolean props
rules.message: The component has more than four boolean props.
rules.fix: Model the variants as a union prop or a variant map.
rules.rationale: Boolean explosions create impossible combinations and hard-to-read call sites.

rules.title: Polymorphic as prop without generic element typing
rules.message: The "as" prop is not typed with a generic element type.
rules.fix: Type it as <T extends ElementType> with ComponentPropsWithoutRef<T>.
rules.rationale: An untyped "as" prop loses prop checking for the rendered element.

rules.title: Primitive does not forward refs (React before 19)
rules.message: A shared UI primitive does not forward its ref.
rules.fix: Wrap it in forwardRef (not needed from React 19).
rules.rationale: Primitives are composed into popovers and forms that need DOM access.

rules.title: More than one exported component per file
rules.message: The file exports more than one component.
rules.fix: Move each component to its own file.
rules.rationale: One component per file keeps imports and reviews focused.

rules.title: Component file longer than 250 lines
rules.message: The component file is longer than 250 lines.
rules.fix: Split it into smaller components or hooks.
rules.rationale: Long components mix concerns and are hard to review.

rules.title: Component defined inside another component
rules.message: A component is defined inside another component's body.
rules.fix: Move it to module scope and pass data through props.
rules.rationale: A nested definition is a new component type on every render, so its state resets.

rules.title: Array index used as key
rules.message: An array index is used as a React key.
rules.fix: Use a stable id from the data.
rules.rationale: Index keys break state and animations when the list is reordered.

rules.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML used
rules.fix: Render structured content, or sanitise the HTML and request a human waiver.
rules.rationale: Injected HTML is the classic route to cross-site scripting.
